ведомость.начало: Creating precise, high-quality images often involves endless trial and error.
Built on the Gemini 3 family of models, Nano Banana models apply deep reasoning
We put together this guide to share exactly what we learned
What you’ll learn in this guide:
Model overview (пункт оглавления)
Full breakdown of tech specs (пункт оглавления)
Best practices for effective prompting (пункт оглавления)
Prompting frameworks (пункт оглавления)
How Nano Banana works with other creative models, Veo and Lyria. (пункт оглавления)
Model overview (заголовок раздела)
Nano Banana models are advanced image generation and editing models that use real-world knowledge
More accurate visuals: Nano Banana 2 is powered by real-time information and images from web search.
Fast, Pro-level features: We’ve unlocked premium features – from text rendering and translations, to upscaling to 2K/4K.
Precision control: Generate or edit images to fit any project requirement, with native support for 16:9, 9:16, 2:1
Breakdown of tech specs for Nano Banana 2 and Nano Banana Pro (заголовок раздела)
Before diving into prompting, here is a breakdown of what the models can handle via the API and Vertex AI
Context windows: Gemini 3.1 Flash Image (Nano Banana 2) supports a maximum of 131,072 input tokens
Resolutions: Built-in generation capabilities for 1K, 2K, and 4K visuals.
Aspect ratios: Both models support 1:1, 3:2, 2:3 …
Image inputs: You can mix up to 14 reference object images in a single prompt.
Document inputs: You can input text and pdf files.
Outputs: Both models output text and images.
Model knowledge base: Both models have a knowledge cutoff date of January 2025.
Live data: Both models are powered by real-time information from web search
Trust & safety: All generated images include C2PA Content Credentials and a SynthID watermark.
To see top features examples, check out this blog.
Best practices for effective prompting (заголовок раздела)
When it comes to effective prompting, there’s a few ways to ensure
Be specific: Provide concrete details on subject, lighting, and composition.
Use positive framing: Describe what you want, not what you don’t want
Control the camera: Use photographic and cinematic terms like “low angle” and “aerial view”.
Iterate: Refine images with follow-up prompts in a conversational manner.
The key is to start a prompt with a strong verb
Five prompting frameworks (заголовок раздела)
1. Image generation (заголовок)
When generating an image, your prompt structure depends entirely on whether you are using reference images
Text-to-image generation without references (заголовок)
When starting with a blank canvas, you are the director.
Formula: [Subject] + [Action] + [Location/context] + [Composition] + [Style]
Example prompt: [Subject] A striking fashion model wearing a tailored brown dress…
Multimodal generation (generation with references) (заголовок)
Gemini allows you to combine multiple reference images to guide the final output.
Formula: [Reference images] + [Relationship instruction] + [New scenario]
Example Prompt: Using the attached napkin sketch as the structure…
Note: Nano Banana generated the source images for the examples below, as well.
2. Image editing (заголовок)
Editing requires a different mindset than generating.
Conversational editing (without new references) (заголовок)
When you generate an image and want to tweak it conversationally:
Semantic masking (inpainting): You can define a "mask" through text
Prompting tip: Be explicit about what to keep exactly the same.
Example prompt: “Remove the man from the photo”
Composition and style transfer (with new references) (заголовок)
Bring new images into the prompt to alter an existing one:
Adding elements: Upload a base image and an object image, and tell the model to combine them.
Style transfer: Upload a photo and ask the model to recreate its exact content in a different artistic style
Composition / Style transfer
3. Real-time information from web search (заголовок)
Gemini Image models can actively search the web to generate images based on real-time information.
How prompting changes: Instead of describing a fictional scene, you instruct the model to retrieve real-world data
The formula: [Source/Search request] + [Analytical task] + [Visual translation]
Example prompt: [Search for current weather and date in San Francisco] + …
prompted on Tuesday 3rd March

ведомость.начало: Nano Banana 2 is powered by real-time information and images from web search. This feature is coming soon to Vertex AI
4. Text rendering & localization (заголовок)
Nano Banana 2 and Nano Banana Pro excel at rendering sharp, legible text
To get the best typographic results, follow these rules:
Use quotes: Enclose your desired words in quotes
Choose a font: Describe the typography style or name of the font.
Translate and localize: Write your prompt in one language and specify a target language
Text-first hack: When generating text for an image, Gemini Image models work best if you first converse with it
Example: A high-end, glossy commercial beauty shot of a sleek, minimalist nude-colored face moisturizer jar…
“A typographic poster with a solid black background, bold letters spell "New York"…
5. Prompting like a Creative Director (заголовок)
To elevate your results from good to breathtaking, you need to stop typing keywords and start directing the scene.
1. Design your lighting (заголовок)
Tell the model exactly how the scene is illuminated.
Studio setups: Ask for a "three-point softbox setup" to evenly light a product.
Dramatic effects: Prompt for "Chiaroscuro lighting with harsh, high contrast" or "Golden hour backlighting creating long shadows".
2. Choose your camera, lens, and focus (заголовок)
Use specific hardware and photographic terminology to control the depth, distortion, and perspective
Hardware: Dictate the exact camera type to change the visual DNA of the image. … GoPro … Fujifilm … disposable camera
Lens: Force the perspective by explicitly requesting a "low-angle shot with a shallow depth of field (f/1.8)".
3. Define the color grading and film stock (заголовок)
The texture and color of the final image set the emotional tone.
If you want a nostalgic or gritty vibe, tell the model to render the image "as if on 1980s color film, slightly grainy".
For a modern, moody aesthetic, ask for "Cinematic color grading with muted teal tones".
4. Emphasize materiality and texture (заголовок)
When generating logos, products, or characters, define their physical makeup.
Go further (заголовок)
Nano Banana Pro and Nano Banana 2 are designed to work seamlessly with our other generative creation models.
Nano Banana + Gemini: Gemini 3 can help you create prompts and with creative direction.
Nano Banana + Veo: Create keyframes with Nano Banana to direct an animation, then use Veo
Nano Banana + Veo + Lyria: Generate your project’s visuals, then add a custom AI soundtrack with Lyria.

единицы.утверждение_en: Text-to-image example following the formula with inline slot labels: a fashion model in a tailored brown dress (Subject), posing with a confident stance (Action), on a deep cherry red studio backdrop (Location), medium-full center-framed shot (Composition), fashion-editorial style on medium-format analog film with grain, high saturation and cinematic lighting (Style).
единицы.цитата: [Subject] A striking fashion model wearing a tailored brown dress, sleek boots, and holding a structured handbag. [Action] Posing with a confident, statuesque stance, slightly turned. [Location/context] A seamless, deep cherry red studio backdrop. [Composition] Medium-full shot, center-framed. [Style] Fashion magazine style editorial, shot on medium-format analog film, pronounced grain, high saturation, cinematic lighting effect.
единицы.раздел: Five prompting frameworks / 1. Image generation / Text-to-image generation without references
единицы.заметка: Каждый слот формулы E-45-28 — отдельное предложение, помеченное меткой в квадратных скобках. Субъект с деталями одежды/аксессуаров; действие с позой ("slightly turned"); фон одним точным описанием цвета; композиция терминами кадра (Medium-full shot, center-framed); стиль = жанр + носитель (medium-format analog film) + фактура (grain) + цвет + свет. Начинается с существительного, не с глагола. Нужно ли оставлять метки в реальном промпте, не сказано.

единицы.утверждение_en: Reference example: "Using the attached napkin sketch as the structure and the attached fabric sample as the texture, transform this into a high-fidelity 3D armchair render. Place it in a sun-drenched, minimalist living room." (with slot labels inline).

единицы.заметка: Три блока формулы E-45-41 в квадратных скобках через "+": поиск (глагол Search) → условное правило преобразования данных ("if raining, make it look grey and rainy") → визуальная концепция (miniature city-in-a-cup в UI смартфона). Последняя скобка в источнике не закрыта. Подпись: "prompted on Tuesday 3rd March".

единицы.цитата: When generating text for an image, Gemini Image models work best if you first converse with it to generate the text concepts, and then ask for an image with that text.

единицы.утверждение_en: Typography example: a glossy commercial beauty shot of a moisturizer jar with three lines of text, each with exact wording in single quotes and a named font ('GLOW' in Brush Script, '10% OFF' in Impact, 'Your First Order' in Century Gothic), followed by an instruction to translate the text into Korean and Arabic.
единицы.цитата: A high-end, glossy commercial beauty shot of a sleek, minimalist nude-colored face moisturizer jar resting on a warm studio background. The lighting is soft and radiant. Next to the product, render three lines of text with the following exact styling: For the top line, the word 'GLOW' in a flowing, elegant Brush Script font. For the middle line, the text '10% OFF' in a heavy, blocky Impact font. For the bottom line, the text 'Your First Order' in a thin, minimalist Century Gothic font." Then translate the text into Korean and Arabic.
единицы.раздел: Five prompting frameworks / 4. Text rendering & localization
единицы.заметка: Структура: жанр и качество кадра → продукт с материалом/цветом → фон → свет → блок текста: место ("Next to the product"), число строк, затем построчно позиция (top/middle/bottom) + точные слова в кавычках + описание шрифта + имя гарнитуры → перевод на другие языки. Перед "Then translate…" в источнике стоит закрывающая кавычка без открывающей — неясно, часть того же промпта это или следующий ход.

единицы.утверждение_en: Typography example: a black-background poster where the bold letters "New York" fill the center and act as a cut-out window, with a photo of the New York skyline visible ONLY inside the letterforms.
единицы.цитата: A typographic poster with a solid black background, bold letters spell "New York", filling the center of the frame. The text acts as a cut-out window. A photograph of New York skyline is visible ONLY inside the letterforms.
единицы.раздел: Five prompting frameworks / 4. Text rendering & localization
единицы.заметка: Текст в кавычках; функция букв задана явно ("acts as a cut-out window"); ограничение выделено заглавными ("ONLY inside the letterforms"). Начинается с типа изображения, не с глагола.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: All three formulas on the page are written as bracketed slots joined by "+" and follow the same logic of "what → how/relationship → visual form"; the examples show slot labels inline in the prompt text (before the fragment in the text-to-image example, after it in the reference example, and as whole bracketed blocks in the web-search example).
длинная_дистанция.заметка: Страница не говорит, надо ли оставлять метки [Subject] и т.п. в настоящем промпте — они выглядят как пояснения авторов.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: The page repeatedly frames prompting as directing rather than listing keywords: describe the scene narratively as the director, stop typing keywords and start directing, and replace generic nouns with material descriptions.
длинная_дистанция.раздел: Five prompting frameworks / Prompting like a Creative Director

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: In the Creative Director section every recommended term is paired with its intended effect (e.g. "three-point softbox setup" to evenly light a product; GoPro for an immersive, distorted action feel; wide-angle lens to show vast scale; macro lens for intricate details; 1980s color film for a nostalgic or gritty vibe).
длинная_дистанция.заметка: Словарь по измерениям: свет → камера (железо) → объектив/фокус → цветокор/плёнка → материалы.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: Web-search grounding availability differs by statement on the page: the overview says Nano Banana 2 uses real-time information and images from web search, the specs say both Nano Banana 2 and Pro are powered by real-time web search, and the web-search section says the feature is coming soon to Vertex AI.
длинная_дистанция.раздел: Model overview / Tech specs / 3. Real-time information from web search
длинная_дистанция.заметка: Картинки из поиска («and images») приписаны только Nano Banana 2.

противоречия_внутри: "The key is to start a prompt with a strong verb" (E-45-25) против формулы text-to-image, начинающейся с [Subject] (E-45-28), и её примера, начинающегося с существительного (E-45-29); примеры с глаголом первым — только в рефах, поиске и правке (E-45-32, E-45-42, E-45-36).
Совет "Be explicit about what to keep exactly the same" (E-45-35) и пример к нему "Remove the man from the photo" (E-45-36) без какой-либо оговорки о сохранении.
Model overview: "native support for 16:9, 9:16, 2:1, and more" (E-45-5), а в спецификациях соотношения 2:1 нет ни у одной модели (E-45-11, E-45-12).
Model overview говорит о 2K/4K как об "upscaling" (E-45-4), спецификации — о встроенной генерации 1K/2K/4K (E-45-10).
не_сказано: Не сказано, как задавать соотношение сторон и разрешение: ни параметров API, ни формулировок в промпте.
Не сказано, нужно ли оставлять в промпте метки слотов в квадратных скобках ([Subject], [References] и т.д.).
Не приведён список "over 10 languages" для текста в кадре.
Nano Banana 2 Lite и оригинальный Nano Banana (gemini-2.5-flash-image) не упомянуты; спецификации только для Nano Banana 2 и Nano Banana Pro.
Нет разбивки лимита 14 рефов по типам (объекты/персонажи/стиль) и по моделям.
Не сказано, как включается веб-поиск (параметр/инструмент) — только формула промпта.
Ничего о thinking-режиме как параметре (уровни, оплата), кроме общего "deep reasoning".
сомнения: Второй признак официальности — авторы: Khulan Davaajav, "Product Marketing Manager, Google Cloud"; Hussain Chinoy, "Technical Solutions Manager" (организация у второго не указана). Строки "© Google LLC" в видимом тексте нет ("Copyright 2024 Google, Inc" встречается только внутри скрипта html).
Пост от March 5, 2026 — старше документации (страница id 1 обновлена 2026-09-23); спецификации могли устареть, блог сам отсылает к документации (E-45-6).
Модель в пункте Aspect ratios названа "Gemini 3.1 Flash Image Preview" — возможно, на момент поста это был preview-идентификатор.
Пример E-45-50: закрывающая кавычка без открывающей перед "Then translate the text into Korean and Arabic." — неясно, это продолжение промпта или отдельный следующий ход.
Кодовых блоков <pre>/<code> на странице нет; видимый текст html совпадает с txt (проверено построчно), альт-тексты картинок — только URL.
